name: Sven Simon - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on amendments to Parliament's Rules of Procedure concerning appointments to Union agencies and bodies (Rule 135)
part_text:
Parliament is changing its own internal rules for how it handles appointments to European Union agencies and bodies. The rule used to cover only a few economic bodies, such as the European Central Bank's supervisory board. Now it will cover appointments to the management boards of regulatory agencies and bodies, and other posts there, but only where Parliament decides on the appointment or must agree to it. Parliament's responsible committee will handle these appointments under rules set by its leadership.

- The rule now covers more EU agencies and bodies, not just economic ones.
- It applies only where Parliament decides or must agree to the appointment.
- The change takes effect on the first day of the next part-session.
